title: 虽然……但是 (Although) in Chinese: HSK 2 Grammar with Examples
description: How to use 虽然……但是 (suīrán… dànshì) in Chinese: the pattern, where 虽然 goes, adding 还是, common mistakes, and 12 HSK 2 example sentences.
h1: How to Say "Although" with 虽然……但是
lede: 虽然 (suīrán) means "although" and 但是 (dànshì) means "but". In Chinese they normally work as a pair: 虽然 introduces a fact, and 但是 introduces something you might not expect because of it.

paras: 虽然 + fact, 但是 + unexpected result.
In English you say either "although" or "but", never both in one sentence. In Chinese, using both is normal and natural: 虽然 starts the first part of the sentence, and 但是 starts the second part.

examples.zh: 虽然这件衣服很贵，但是很漂亮。
examples.py: Suīrán zhè jiàn yīfu hěn guì, dànshì hěn piàoliang.
examples.en: Although this piece of clothing is expensive, it's very pretty.

examples.zh: 虽然汉语不好学，但是很有意思。
examples.py: Suīrán Hànyǔ bù hǎo xué, dànshì hěn yǒu yìsi.
examples.en: Although Chinese isn't easy to learn, it's very interesting.

examples.zh: 虽然他是中国人，但是他不会做中国菜。
examples.py: Suīrán tā shì Zhōngguó rén, dànshì tā bú huì zuò Zhōngguó cài.
examples.en: Although he's Chinese, he can't cook Chinese food.

sections.h2: Where 虽然 and 但是 go
paras: 虽然 can come before or after the subject of the first part: 虽然他很忙 and 他虽然很忙 are both correct. When both parts are about the same person, you don't need to say the subject again after 但是.
但是 is different: it always comes at the very start of the second part, before the subject. Negatives with 不 and 没有 work as usual inside each part.

examples.zh: 虽然他很忙，但是每天都学习汉语。
examples.py: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì měi tiān dōu xuéxí Hànyǔ.
examples.en: Although he's busy, he studies Chinese every day.

examples.zh: 他虽然很忙，但是每天都学习汉语。
examples.py: Tā suīrán hěn máng, dànshì měi tiān dōu xuéxí Hànyǔ.
examples.en: Although he's busy, he studies Chinese every day.

examples.zh: 我虽然很累，但是不想睡觉。
examples.py: Wǒ suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì bù xiǎng shuìjiào.
examples.en: Although I'm tired, I don't want to go to sleep.

sections.h2: 但是 on its own, and adding 还是
paras: 但是 can be used without 虽然, just like "but" in English. 虽然, on the other hand, is rarely left on its own: the second part normally has 但是, 还是 or both.
还是 here means "still" or "anyway". It goes after the subject of the second part, before the verb.

examples.zh: 这个饭馆不大，但是菜很好吃。
examples.py: Zhège fànguǎn bú dà, dànshì cài hěn hǎochī.
examples.en: This restaurant isn't big, but the food is very good.

examples.zh: 虽然天气不好，但是我们还是去了。
examples.py: Suīrán tiānqì bù hǎo, dànshì wǒmen háishi qù le.
examples.en: Although the weather wasn't good, we still went.

examples.zh: 虽然医生说他要多休息，他还是去上班了。
examples.py: Suīrán yīshēng shuō tā yào duō xiūxi, tā háishi qù shàngbān le.
examples.en: Although the doctor told him to rest more, he went to work anyway.

paras: The most common mistake is to put 但是 after the subject, as in 虽然他很忙，他但是每天都来. 但是 must come first: 虽然他很忙，但是他每天都来.
Another mistake is mixing up the two pairs 虽然……但是 (although… but) and 因为……所以 (because… so). 虽然 goes with 但是, and 因为 goes with 所以. 虽然……所以 and 因为……但是 are both wrong.

examples.zh: 因为太贵了，所以我没有买。
examples.py: Yīnwèi tài guì le, suǒyǐ wǒ méiyǒu mǎi.
examples.en: Because it was too expensive, I didn't buy it.

examples.py: Suīrán hěn guì, dànshì wǒ mǎi le.
examples.en: Although it was expensive, I bought it.

examples.zh: 虽然他很忙，但是他每天都来。
examples.py: Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì tā měi tiān dōu lái.
examples.en: Although he's busy, he comes every day.

worksheet.title: 虽然……但是 Worksheet: HSK 2 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 虽然……但是 worksheet for HSK 2: 18 exercises (虽然, 但是, 因为 or 所以, word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.h2: Choose 虽然, 但是, 因为 or 所以
exercises.instructions: Write 虽然, 但是, 因为 or 所以 in each gap. The English tells you what the sentence means.

items.zh: ＿＿天气很冷，但是孩子们还在外面玩。
items.en: Although it's cold, the children are still playing outside.

items.zh: 虽然这个菜很好吃，＿＿太贵了。
items.en: Although this dish is tasty, it's too expensive.
Because it was raining, we didn't go out.

items.zh: 因为他生病了，＿＿今天没有来上课。
items.en: Because he's ill, he didn't come to class today.

items.zh: 我＿＿学了两年汉语，但是说得不太好。
items.en: Although I've studied Chinese for two years, I don't speak it very well.

items.zh: 虽然她只有二十岁，＿＿已经是医生了。
items.en: Although she's only twenty, she's already a doctor.
Although he's tired, he's still working.

items.zh: 因为明天有考试，＿＿我今天不看电视了。
items.en: Because I have an exam tomorrow, I'm not watching TV today.

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence with 虽然 and 但是.

items.en: Although it's already very late, he's still working.
answers: 虽然已经很晚了，但是他还在工作。

items.en: Although this phone is expensive, I still want to buy it.
answers: 虽然这个手机很贵，但是我还是想买。
这个手机虽然很贵，但是我还是想买。

items.en: Although he can't speak Chinese, he can understand it.
answers: 虽然他不会说汉语，但是能听懂。
他虽然不会说汉语，但是能听懂。
虽然不会说汉语，但是他能听懂。

items.en: Although my older brother is tall, I'm not.
answers: 虽然哥哥很高，但是我不高。
哥哥虽然很高，但是我不高。

items.en: Although it's cold outside, it's hot in the room.
answers: 虽然外面很冷，但是房间里很热。

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.zh: 虽然他很忙，他但是每天都运动。
items.en: Although he's busy, he exercises every day.
answers: 虽然他很忙，但是他每天都运动。

items.zh: 虽然这个饭馆很远，所以我们每个星期都去。
items.en: Although this restaurant is far away, we go there every week.
answers: 虽然这个饭馆很远，但是我们每个星期都去。

items.zh: 因为他是老师，但是他不喜欢看书。
items.en: Although he's a teacher, he doesn't like reading.
answers: 虽然他是老师，但是他不喜欢看书。

items.zh: 虽然我不喜欢吃鱼，还是我吃了一点儿。
items.en: Although I don't like fish, I still ate a little.
answers: 虽然我不喜欢吃鱼，我还是吃了一点儿。
虽然我不喜欢吃鱼，但是我还是吃了一点儿。
虽然我不喜欢吃鱼，但是我吃了一点儿。

items.zh: 虽然她很想去中国，她但是没有钱。
items.en: Although she really wants to go to China, she doesn't have the money.
answers: 虽然她很想去中国，但是她没有钱。
